candidates.label: Delete in the same attempt targeted within 15 minutes, with an independent cleanup supervisor required before any effect
evidence: WORK-PACK.md:120 requires retention duration and expiry behavior.
The memory and PostgreSQL repositories implement and test exact idempotent evidence disposition.
Same-process finally cleanup covers normal failures; an independently validated cleanup supervisor is required before any effect to cover primary-process termination.
The 15-minute value is an operating target, not a crash-safe retention ceiling, until that supervisor is admitted.

candidates.label: Retain for at most 24 hours, then perform operator-driven deletion
evidence: The existing exact disposition operation can be invoked by an operator at a recorded deadline.
No automatic expiry scheduler exists, so this option carries greater operational and privacy risk than same-attempt deletion.

candidates.label: Retain evidence indefinitely
rejectionReasons: Indefinite retention supplies no expiry behavior and exceeds the bounded single-witness purpose.

candidates.label: Defer retention selection
evidence: Deferral stores no real evidence and leaves SWU-BWSL-002 blocked.

candidates.label: Stop the real-witness sequence
evidence: Stopping creates no real evidence requiring retention.
